title: Where a build tool's modules are declared, and what proves each (ADR-025 amendment 4)
description: Published by a build tool's adapter. `areas` reads it to draft one area per module the host's manifest declares -- its path, and the vouched command that proves it -- and one area for the tool's own declarations; the owner approves the draft. Two forms: the MANIFEST form (`path`, `pointer`, `path_field`) names where a build tool declares its modules; the MARKER form (`markers`, `command`) finds a module in every carried directory holding a marker file, and `areas` drafts the policy command (`command`, `{path}` the module's directory) its `proof` names.

path.description: the manifest that declares the modules

pointer.description: where in it the modules are, by id

path_field.description: the field of a module that is its path

proof.description: the vouched command that proves a module, `{id}` its id

declarations.description: paths (regular expressions) holding the tool's own declarations

markers.description: file names whose directory is a module

marker_pointer.description: a module only where the marker (JSON) holds a value here

command.description: the command proving a module, `{path}` its directory
